mechanism: Both drugs can prolong QT interval through different mechanisms (fluoroquinolone and macrolide effects on cardiac potassium channels), with potential additive cardiac effects; erythromycin may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism of ciprofloxacin.
action: Monitor QTc interval and ECG; use combination cautiously in patients with cardiac risk factors, electrolyte abnormalities, or baseline QT prolongation; consider alternative antibiotics if possible.
